question: Should OpenClaw expose internal agent tool-call telemetry through `/v1/chat/completions`, and if so under what redaction and authorization contract?
rationale: The current shipped API contract excludes internal tools, while exposing them would cross a security and compatibility boundary that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep current Chat Completions contract
options.body: Leave `tool_calls` as caller-supplied client-tool protocol and route internal tool debugging to diagnostics, trajectory, or audit surfaces with explicit documentation.

options.title: Design an explicit diagnostic mode
options.body: Add a separate opt-in, redacted, scope-gated API or diagnostic field for internal tool telemetry with tests and docs before implementation.

options.title: Expose internals directly
options.body: Return internal tool calls in Chat Completions responses, accepting a broader compatibility and sensitive-data exposure risk.

recommendation.title: Keep current Chat Completions contract
recommendation.body: Leave `tool_calls` as caller-supplied client-tool protocol and route internal tool debugging to diagnostics, trajectory, or audit surfaces with explicit documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision combines Gateway API compatibility and security/product policy, and this owner appears in the merge/proof history for the current client-tool contract.
